architecture.name: IRIS_CROSSFIT_EVIDENCE_STACK_V1

inner_crossfit.unit: complete SEP episode / predeclared quiet block
inner_crossfit.purpose: Generate out-of-fold specialist predictions for meta-fusion without using calibration, threshold, score or monitor labels.

architecture.meta_features: For each specialist, centered evidence = clip(logit(p_expert)-logit(fold_train_prevalence), -6, 6). XRS/proton evidence is multiplied by finite-feature coverage reliability.
architecture.final_fit: Refit each specialist on the complete outer fit role. Apply frozen meta weights to full-fit-prevalence-centered expert evidence.
architecture.calibration: Fit one logit intercept on calibration role only after meta weights are frozen.
architecture.threshold: Select MAX_TSS and POD80_MIN_FAR on threshold role only.

paired_bootstrap.unit: complete SEP episode / predeclared quiet block

motivation.failure_learned_from_residual_v1: Hard-wiring solar coefficient to one caused the context weights to collapse and materially underperformed the existing late-fusion model.
motivation.systems_principle: Use cross-fitting to spend training labels on fusion while keeping calibration and threshold roles semantically pure.

selection_rule: No hyperparameter changes after score/monitor inspection. Promote only if cross-fitted stack improves robustness over existing late fusion without material ranking/calibration degradation; otherwise retain existing late fusion.
claim_rule: Score and monitor are already-inspected development evidence. This experiment cannot establish final external superiority.
